cohort: The study included 412 neonates admitted to Felege-Hiwot Referral Hospital.
finding: Preterm birth, low birth weight, prolonged rupture of membranes, and caesarean section mode of delivery were statistically associated with bacteriologically confirmed neonatal sepsis, predominantly caused by multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae and Staphylococcus aureus.
mod_finding: Caesarean section mode of delivery was statistically associated with bacteriologically confirmed neonatal sepsis.
